items.title: Independence of the cotangent complex from the chosen simplicial resolution
items.statement: For a ring map $A\to B$, any two simplicial resolutions $P_\bullet\to B$ and $Q_\bullet\to B$ by polynomial $A$-algebras with weak-equivalence augmentations ([[def-cotangent-complex-of-a-ring-map]]) give complexes $\Omega_{P_\bullet/A}\otimes_{P_\bullet}B$ and $\Omega_{Q_\bullet/A}\otimes_{Q_\bullet}B$ that are canonically quasi-isomorphic; consequently $L_{B/A}$ depends only on $A\to B$ up to canonical isomorphism in the derived category $D(B)$ ([[def-derived-category-of-an-abelian-category]], [[def-quasi-isomorphism]]). Moreover the cotangent complex is compatible with base change: if $B=B\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}A'$, then $L_{B/A}\simeq L_{B/A'}$ in $D(B)$.
items.strategy: Stacks, *The Cotangent Complex*, Sections 92.4 and 92.6-92.8: Lemma 92.4.1 (tag 08PS), Lemma 92.4.2 (tag 08PT), Lemma 92.4.3 (tag 08PU), Lemma 92.4.7 (tag 08QH) and Lemma 92.8.1 (tag 08QZ). ESCALATED: the complete local proof requires the derived-lower-shriek formalism for simplicial algebras (Stacks 92.4-92.6), the model structure on simplicial modules, and the trivial-Kan-fibration property of the standard resolution; those prerequisites are not scaffolded on this page. The independently retrieved treatment (Toen, Section 4.1) states the result without proof, so the independent-treatment requirement is also unmet. Exact needed chain: (i) the standard resolution is a trivial Kan fibration (92.4.1); (ii) $L\pi_!$ computes the associated complex for any resolution (92.4.2); (iii) the identification with $L\pi_!(i^*\Omega)$ (92.4.3); (iv) comparison of two resolutions by a zig-zag of weak equivalences; (v) base change (92.8.1). Owner action required: authorize a separate simplicial-derived-functor prerequisite pair, or supply a complete independent proof. The statement itself is certain; local proof closure is the blocker.

items.title: Derived schemes and the cotangent complex of a morphism
items.statement: A derived scheme is a pair $(X,\mathcal O_X)$ consisting of a topological space $X$ and a sheaf $\mathcal O_X$ of simplicial commutative rings on $X$ ([[def-simplicial-object-and-simplicial-commutative-ring]]) such that (1) the ringed space $(X,\pi_0(\mathcal O_X))$ is a scheme ([[def-scheme]]) and (2) for every $i>0$ the homotopy sheaf $\pi_i(\mathcal O_X)$ is a quasi-coherent module on that scheme ([[def-quasi-coherent-module-scheme]]). Every scheme $X$ is a derived scheme with $\mathcal O_X$ the constant simplicial sheaf of rings; truncation $t_0\colon(X,\mathcal O_X)\mapsto(X,\pi_0(\mathcal O_X))$ is a functor to schemes, and $t_0$ is left adjoint to the inclusion of schemes into derived schemes. For a morphism of derived schemes $f\colon X\to Y$, the cotangent complex $L_{X/Y}$ is the complex of $\pi_0(\mathcal O_X)$-modules obtained by gluing the affine cotangent complexes $L_{B/A}$ of [[def-cotangent-complex-of-a-ring-map]] over affine charts: for affine derived schemes $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ the module $L_{B/A}$ is placed as a quasi-coherent complex on the truncation, and the affine-local complexes glue to a quasi-coherent complex on $X$.
items.strategy: Definition 2.1 and the surrounding discussion in Toen, *Derived algebraic geometry*, Sections 2.1-2.2 (derived schemes as simplicial-ringed spaces, the truncation functor, schemes as constant derived schemes), combined with Stacks, *The Cotangent Complex*, Definition 92.3.2 for the affine model. ESCALATED: the morphism-level cotangent complex requires both resolution independence ([[lem-cotangent-complex-resolution-independence]], itself escalated) and compatibility with localization and base change, i.e. Stacks Lemma 92.8.1 (tag 08QZ) and the gluing of the affine complexes over the truncation. Those prerequisites are not locally closed, and the independent derived-AG text retrieved (Toen) explicitly gives definitions without proofs, so the independent-treatment requirement is unmet for this half of the item. The derived-scheme definition itself (conditions (1)-(2), the constant embedding and the truncation functor) is complete and may be authored now; the cotangent-complex half is blocked on [[lem-cotangent-complex-resolution-independence]].
